firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 states trade + city + outcome in 7 words. One primary action ('Price it') plus secondary ('Call'). Phone visible in header. Next band peeks ~80px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 'Coat Schedule' stripe motif appears in hero, process section, and footer (>=4 sections). Layout families are somewhat standard for niche. Signature exists but layout variety could be stronger.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Sora/Outfit pairing clean. Fluid scale works. Body >=16px, measure ~65ch. Tabular numerals in pricing/hours. Deduction: -0.5 for straight quotes in review cards.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Good rhythm of tones (deep/light/paper/deep/accent/light/deep). Asymmetric splits. Deduction: -0.5 for two dark bands appearing close at scroll transition; -0.5 for centered guarantee paragraph >3 lines.

photo.notes: render.json: placeholderCount 10. All images are grey placeholder boxes. No real photography to evaluate. Floor score applied.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Voice specific and contractor-authentic. Buttons named for action. Sample labels present on all reviews/pricing/guarantee. Microcopy under form. Consistent primary action name.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: No horizontal scroll. Tap targets >=48px. Sticky mobile bar hides on scroll down. Hero re-cropped. h1 <=4 lines. ZIP checker usable with thumb.

a11y.notes: 1440-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg: All content visible (R2 bug fixed). Skip link present. Focus styles defined. Labels on all inputs. Heading order correct. Honeypot hidden.

motion.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Reveal animations present. Intro quick. Hover states on buttons. Reduced motion respected. Deduction: -0.5 for identical fade-up reveal on most sections.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Coat Schedule concept is static. Numbered process steps serve as signature moment. Deduction: -1.0 because wow moment is not interactive or memorable enough to show partner.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG tags, JSON-LD present. Consistent radius. Print stylesheet included. Deduction: -0.5 for mixed icon stroke widths in mobile bar.

mustFix.fix: Replace all placeholder images with approved media from niches/painter/media/manifest.json using [[img]] macros. Ensure hero, process, and proof sections have on-topic, region-appropriate frames with consistent grade.

elevate.move: Source and integrate approved media that tells a sequence (prep -> work -> result) with consistent color grading. Apply the coat-stripe motif as a frame treatment or clip-path mask to make photography part of the signature system.
Transform the static Coat Schedule into an interactive estimator where users select room count or exterior surface and receive a printable spec sheet styled in the signature language.
